features.label: Features
features.heading: Everything you need to sell online
features.subheading: Built specifically for Armenian entrepreneurs — from payments to product management, all in one place.
features.templates_desc: Switch your store design anytime. Multiple themes to match your brand, no coding required.
features.payments_desc: Accept Idram and local bank transfers. Built for Armenian businesses from day one.
